# Maven Decoratives

> Maven Decoratives develops bespoke decorative lighting for hospitality, commercial and residential projects across India.

## What Maven Does

Maven develops custom decorative lighting from references, concepts, sketches or BOQs through design development, engineering, material and finish selection, sampling, manufacturing development, fabrication and project delivery.

## Lighting

- Custom chandeliers
- Custom pendant lighting
- Wall sconces
- Feature lighting
- Custom decorative fixtures
- Hospitality decorative lighting

## Technical Approach

Maven considers the complete fixture, including:

- Light quality: CRI, CCT, lumen output, beam angle and glare
- Controls: drivers, Triac, 0–10V, DALI and project requirements
- Scale: diameter, height, drop, proportion and viewing distance
- Construction: weight, structure, joints, fixing, safety and ceiling conditions
- Materials: metal, glass, crystal, stone, fabric and mixed finishes
- Manufacturing: fabrication, assembly, finishing and quality control
- Coordination: RCPs, drivers, wiring, access, maintenance and installation

## Project Approach

Reference → Interpretation → Material → Development → Sampling → Production → Delivery

## Who Maven Works With

- Architects
- Interior designers
- Lighting consultants
- PMCs and project teams
- Procurement teams
- Developers and owners
